text.body:
prathamaḥ sargaḥ
śrīkaṇṭhakāntāstu satāṃ sukhāya nakhendukānticchurito yadaṅghriḥ| 1.1ab hasannivābhāti mahendrahetimakhaṇḍitoddaṇḍalulāpalomām|| 1.1cd
sa vaḥ śivāyāścaraṇaḥ śriye 'stu raktākṣaraktokṣitamāhave yam| 1.2ab prakṣālayanti sma samaṃ namantaḥ pramodabāṣpāmbubhireva devāḥ|| 1.2cd
dantāntarālapraṇayīni yuddhājire 'rdhajagdhānyapi jaṅgalāni| 1.3ab kaniṣṭhikāgreṇa kilākṛṣantī bhadrāṇi vaḥ puṣyatu bhadrakālī|| 1.3cd
mīnadhvajaprajvalanāparādhātpuraḥ purāṇāṃ praṇamatyamitre| 1.4ab ratermukhaṃ smeramupājigāya vilokayantī girijā mude 'stu|| 1.4cd
sā vaḥ śivāyāstu śivā yadīyasākūtadṛkpātaguruṃ girīśaḥ| 1.5ab nādyāpi jīrṇaṃ jarayatyudīrṇamantarvikurvāṇamayugmabāṇam|| 1.5cd
sarasvatīpāṇisarojavīṇā prīṇātu sā vaḥ sarasaṃ rasantī| 1.6ab yataḥ sruteva śravaṇāmṛtormirjihvāsu vāsaṃ kurute kavīnām|| 1.6cd
jagattraye 'pi trijagatsavitrī dadhātu dhāturduhitā hitāni| 1.7ab yatpādapadmadvayasevayeva kavitvamāpadyata mīnahaṃsaḥ|| 1.7cd
dugdhādabhivyaktavapuḥ sudhāyāḥ svasā ca miśrā madhunāśanena| 1.8ab kṛtādhivāsā kamalairitīva yā lobhanīyā jagatāṃ stumastām|| 1.8cd
punarbhavakleśavināśinīnāṃ panthāḥ śrutīnāmupatiṣṭhate yam| 1.9ab nato 'smi hṛllocanagocarāya kasmaicidasmai parameśvarāya|| 1.9cd
śrutisravantīnaganāyakāya pitāmahāya praṇato 'smi tasmai| 1.10ab vāgdevatāṃ viṣṭapamātaraṃ yaḥ sṛṣṭvāpi mātāmahatāmavāpa|| 1.10cd
kṣamāvatāmādyatamāya tasmai viśvaikanāthāya namaskaromi| 1.11ab vakraṃ ca pādairapi ca spṛśantaṃ doṣākaraṃ yaḥ śirasā bibharti|| 1.11cd
smaradviṣaḥ pātu śiraḥsaridvaḥ kṛśaṃ vapuryatsavidhe dadhānaḥ| 1.12ab duḥkhena sakhyuḥ kusumāyudhasya tapasyatīvordhvakaraḥ sudhāṃśuḥ|| 1.12cd
ugraḥ svayaṃ gehavatī ca caṇḍī putro 'gnibhūḥ saṃnihitā dvijihvāḥ| 1.13ab evaṃprakāro 'pi paraṃ ya ekaḥ kalyāṇaheturjagatāṃ sa pātu|| 1.13cd
vande sadaikaṃ śivayoḥ śarīraṃ yadvāmabhāge kucakumbhadambhāt| 1.14ab avāptamṛtyuryudhi liṅgarūpī vīraḥ svayambhūrudabhūnmanobhūḥ|| 1.14cd
dhātāyamekaḥ patatāmiheti matveva patyā patatāṃ śrito yaḥ| 1.15ab mude sa devo 'stu sadā madāndhadaiteyadantīndraharirharirvaḥ| 1.15cd
pādāgradaghne vidadhatpayodhau keliṃ sa kolaḥ kurutānmudaṃ vaḥ| 1.16ab daṃṣṭrāvilagnāmavaniṃ viveda yastatkṛtābhiḥ stutighoṣaṇābhiḥ|| 1.16cd
puṃskesarī pātu sa vaḥ stavārthamāyatsu yasya tridaśeṣu harṣāt| 1.17ab gandhopalambhe 'pi bhayānnivṛttaṃ śaśvanmadena dviradānanena|| 1.17cd
sa pātu govardhanabhārakhinnayadaṅgasaṃvāhanakaitavena| 1.18ab gopyo gurūṇāṃ purato 'pyaśaṅkamavāpurāśleṣasukhaṃ smarārtāḥ|| 1.18cd
rādhāstu siddhyai rativigrahe yā prattaṃ priyeṇādharamityapāsthat| 1.19ab prayaccha tasyai tava cakriṇo 'pi pratigrahe 'sminrucirasti yasyāḥ|| 1.19cd
śriye 'stu rāmastava yaḥ palāśasamitsamiddhe nijaśauryavahnau| 1.20ab daśāsyarājyaṃ surabhīdamājyamivāsijuhvā juhavāṃcakāra|| 1.20cd
vande videhādhipatestanūjāṃ yasyāḥ parityāgakathāprathāsu| 1.21ab sā rāmabhadrasya yaśaḥpraśastirviśvapriyāpyapriyatāṃ prayāti|| 1.21cd
bhagnogradhanvā janakopakārī rāmo 'stu bhartā na tu rāvaṇo me| 1.22ab yā nityamityarthayate sma gaurīṃ guruḥ kathaṃ strīṣu na maithilī sā|| 1.22cd
lambodarasyendusahodaraśrīrdanto 'stu saṃtoṣasamṛddhaye vaḥ| 1.23ab madasravantīsavidhasthito yaḥ sitacchadasya cchavimāchinatti|| 1.23cd
vilolayanmaulimanekavelamanekapāsyaḥ samupāsyatāṃ saḥ| 1.24ab yaḥ pratyahaṃ svapraṇatipriyebhyaḥ pradātumākārayatīva siddhim|| 1.24cd
tanmaṇḍalaṃ caṇḍaruceḥ śucaṃ vaśchinattu daityāripurapratolī| 1.25ab yatrāṅkuraśreṇinibhā vibhāti bhāsāṃ tatistoraṇamālikeva|| 1.25cd
bhāvena vande 'hamaśītaraśmiṃ datte navaṃ dehamadehināṃ yaḥ| 1.26ab kṛtvā tamohānimupaskaroti yaḥ śāntamohāni ca diṅmukhāni|| 1.26cd
vīraḥ smaro bhīruparicchado 'pi vandyaḥ sa yasmādapi bhasmitāṅgāt| 1.27ab śaṅke śaśāṅkābharaṇaḥ saśaṅko durgāśrayaṃ muñcati nādhunāpi|| 1.27cd
tābhyastisṛbhyo 'pi namaḥ śrutibhyaḥ śreyaḥsutānyajjanitāndadhānā| 1.28ab mahāmunīnāṃ kila maṇḍalīyamālambate bālakapālakatvam|| 1.28cd
jayanti viśvatrayahetavaste yeṣāṃ bahūnāṃ mukhamekameva| 1.29ab jayatyasāvapyavitarkyamūrtirekasya bhūyāṃsi mukhāni yasya|| 1.29cd
mukhyaṃ munīnāmiva taṃ kavīnāṃ namāmi yenāgamakovidena| 1.30ab svakāvyadevāyatane 'dhidevī pratiṣṭhitā rāghavakīrtimūrtiḥ|| 1.30cd
ṛcāṃ rahasyaṃ yajuṣāṃ vivartaḥ sāraṃ ca sāmnāṃ dhuri bandhurāṇām| 1.31ab kṛtiryadīyā pṛṇati trilokīṃ taṃ satyavatyāstanayaṃ stavīmi|| 1.31cd
upadrutadroṇamapāstasindhurājaṃ virājatpavanātmajena| 1.32ab sarāmavṛttaṃ harivaṃśahāri rāmāyaṇaṃ bhāratavannato 'smi|| 1.32cd
yaḥ prākṛtoktyaiva mahākavīnāmagauravaṃ devagirāṃ cakāra| 1.33ab bṛhatkathāmasya na manyate kaḥ kaverguṇāḍhyasya bṛhatkatheti|| 1.33cd
satyena sāhityarasena siddhāḥ satyaṃ subandhupramukhāḥ kavīndrāḥ| 1.34ab tathā hyadṛśyeṣvapi yeṣu sākṣādākarṇyate karṇasukhā taduktiḥ|| 1.34cd
śrīkālidāsasya vaco vicārya naivānyakāvye ramate matirme| 1.35ab kiṃ pārijātaṃ parihṛtya hanta bhṛṅgālirānandati sindhuvāre|| 1.35cd
śaṅke cirānmāghamurārimukhyāḥ sthāsyanti susthāḥ savidhe vidhātuḥ| 1.36ab pravartitā yairnijavāgvibhūtivyājena loke madhudugdhakulyāḥ|| 1.36cd
sarasvatīṃ śaśvadupāsate ye gṛhṇanti nārthānapi ye pareṣām| 1.37ab vittāśca vṛttairyatisevitairyaiḥ kiṃ medhyamebhyo 'pyaparaṃ kavibhyaḥ|| 1.37cd
rasapradhānaiḥ kavitāvitānairmānyā na mānyāḥ kavayo vayobhiḥ| 1.38ab tejoviśeṣānmaṇayo 'rhaṇīyā bhavanti na prastaravatprathimnā|| 1.38cd
parasya kāvyaṃ svamiti bruvāṇo vijñāyate jñairiha kāvyacauraḥ| 1.39ab vilokya māṇikyamayogyahaste pratyeti ko nāma yadetadasya|| 1.39cd
kāvyaṃ paroktaiḥ kriyate yadarthaiḥ kṛtena kastena guṇo 'sti kartuḥ| 1.40ab yajjīvatastasya bahuśrutebhyaḥ śaṅkā vipannasya na cātra kīrtiḥ|| 1.40cd
praṇamyatāmaskhalitapravāhā sarasvatī sā kavipuṅgavānām| 1.41ab alabdhasaṃdhyā na khalu praveṣṭuṃ duṣṭairbakoṭairiva śakyate yā|| 1.41cd
rasāśrayā vakratayā ca ramyā vyākurvatī kāñcanakāntimuccaiḥ| 1.42ab sūktiḥ kaveḥ kasyacideva vaktre vibhāti daṃṣṭreva kirīśvarasya|| 1.42cd
kiṃ so 'pi kāvyasya rasaḥ praśasyo yaḥ pīyamānaḥ śravaṇāñjalibhyām| 1.43ab śrotuḥ pramodāśruśiraḥprakampairna darśayatyāśu vapurvikāram|| 1.43cd
jayanti te sajjanavārivāhāḥ sarvapramodāya kṛtodyamairyaiḥ| 1.44ab yavāsakānāmiva durjanānāṃ deheṣu dāhaḥ paramujjihīte|| 1.44cd
khinnātmanāṃ niḥśvasitānilena duḥkhānale 'ntarjvalituṃ pravṛtte| 1.45ab śyāmāyamānāni mukhāni yeṣāṃ dhūmabhramaṃ bibhrati te namasyāḥ|| 1.45cd
agāliśālīni samantato 'pi cchāyāmanujjhanti manobhirāmām| 1.46ab mahātmanāmānanakānanāni na kasya saṃtāpabharaṃ haranti|| 1.46cd
te ke 'pyabhūvankṛtinaḥ kṛtārthāṃ kṛtvā bhuvaṃ yaistridivaṃ vrajadbhiḥ| 1.47ab jāne janāniṣṭanivāraṇāya svanāmasaṃkīrtanamatra muktam|| 1.47cd
iyaṃ pravṛttirmahatāṃ kutastyā yadabruvanto 'pyupakurvate 'mī| 1.48ab vinā prasūnāni phalaprasūtirvilokitā tairnu vanaspatīnām|| 1.48cd
ciraṃ parīkṣasva nijasvabhāvāccalanti naivottamavaṃśajātāḥ| 1.49ab itastato vāpi vidhūyamānamaṅgeṣu śaityaṃ vyajanaṃ vyanakti|| 1.49cd
upekṣate yatkhalamākṣipantaṃ sādhurmayābudhyata kāraṇaṃ tat| 1.50ab dvijihmamenaṃ sa yadekajihvaḥ prayuktibhirna kramate niyantum|| 1.50cd
kṣamāmahaṃkārabhareṇa yeṣāṃ padāni cittāni ca na spṛśanti| 1.51ab tadekasāraiḥ kalahaṃ kulīnaiḥ khalāścikīrṣanti kimakṣamāste|| 1.51cd
babhūva bhūyastvamasajjanānāṃ dvitrā dharitryāmapi hanta santaḥ| 1.52ab pade pade santyathavā bhujaṅgāḥ kvacittu saṃjīvanabheṣajāni|| 1.52cd
aho mahāmohavataḥ khalasya viyātatā kācidacintanīyā| 1.53ab avarṇavādaikaviśārado 'sau sarvajñatāmātmani manyate yat|| 1.53cd
khalaśca khaḍgaśca na hi svabhāvaṃ jahāti kośārpaṇalālito 'pi| 1.54ab yasyātimātraṃ malinātmakasya paraṃ dvidhākurvata eva rāgaḥ|| 1.54cd
parakṣatakṣodavinodalīlāḥ khalāśca kākāśca yadṛcchayaiva| 1.55ab pātre 'pyapātre 'pi vigarhaṇīyāṃ vācaṃ ca viṣṭhāṃ ca samutsṛjanti|| 1.55cd
he citta citrairiha viṣṭapasya duśceṣṭitaistairlikhitaiḥ kimetaiḥ| 1.56ab yadanyadoṣekṣaṇadakṣiṇānāṃ jihvaiva vṛttāntapaṭaḥ sphuṭo 'sti|| 1.56cd
varaṃ varākaḥ prakaṭāpakārī gūḍhāpakāryapratikārya eva| 1.57ab dūreṇa muñcantyanalaṃ jvalantaṃ channaṃ jano vetti tu dagdhapādaḥ|| 1.57cd
śakto 'pi vaktuṃ khalavatkulīnaḥ parāpavādānna khalu vyanakti| 1.58ab na dhvāṅkṣavattīkṣṇatarānano 'pi kīraḥ karotyasthivighaṭṭanāni|| 1.58cd
na kasya bhītyai nṛpatiprasādatāmbūlaraktā rasanā khalānām| 1.59ab anantajantukṣataniḥsṛtāsṛkkaṇāruṇā saunikakartarīva|| 1.59cd
svacchasvabhāvo 'pi bhavatyavaśyamanyādṛganyāyijanāśrayeṇa| 1.60ab viṣānuṣaṅgeṇa hi jīvanīyaṃ jīvāpahārāya samujjihīte|| 1.60cd
yaḥ sarvadā saṃsadi nirmimīte marmāpidhānaṃ janatāpahantā| 1.61ab sa śasyatāmantaraduṣṭabhāvaḥ kulodbhavaścāpyakulodbhavaśca|| 1.61cd
prāyo vayaṃ vedavicārapāravaśyena kāvye na tathābhiyuktāḥ| 1.62ab durge 'tra mārge tadapi pravṛttā nopekṣitavyāḥ kavibhiḥ skhalantaḥ|| 1.62cd
ko vā kariṣyatyaparaḥ prabandhamatiprabuddho 'pyapaśabdaśūnyam| 1.63ab sargakrame so 'pi kaviryadādyaḥ khalacchalena skhalitānyavāpa|| 1.63cd
cakre mayā kāvyapariśramo 'yaṃ bahuśrutānāmanurañjanāya| 1.64ab na sūtramātrārthakathāvabodhavidagdhatādhaḥkṛtavedhasāṃ tu|| 1.64cd
babhūva bhūpaḥ surathābhidhānaścaitrānvaye caitrasakhopameyaḥ| 1.65ab svanāmasāmyākṣamayeva yuddhe yenārisainyaṃ surathaṃ na sehe|| 1.65cd
yaṃ nirviśeṣātsma niṣevate śrīrekādaśaṃ śrīdayitāvatāram| 1.66ab kīrṇaṃ rajobhiḥ samarājirotthaisturaṅgamedhāvabhṛthaiśca śuddham|| 1.66cd
nirandhakārāṃ kurute dharitrīṃ kāle ravirvarṣati vārido 'pi| 1.67ab pravṛttiretasya sadā tu dāturnirantarāyā bhuvanāvanāya|| 1.67cd
dharmakṣatereva bhayaṃ svabhāvavakraḥ priyaḥ kārmukadaṇḍa eva| 1.68ab vipakṣalakṣmīgraha eva laulyamadeyamāsīdyaśa eva yasya|| 1.68cd
gacchadbhiricchādhikamarthadānairyasyābhimānaikaniketanasya| 1.69ab paścātkṛtaḥ svīkṛtiniḥsvanānāṃ dūraprayāto 'pi dhanābhilāṣaḥ|| 1.69cd
yatkarma kūrmoragasūkarendrāḥ kalpadrucintāmaṇikāmagavyaḥ| 1.70ab sambhūya kurvanti tadeka eva cakre mahīcakraśatakraturyaḥ|| 1.70cd
yacchannatucchaṃ gajavājivṛndadānaṃ dvijānāmavadānavānyaḥ| 1.71ab bhālasthitāṃ candanapaṅkalepacchalena dāridryalipiṃ lulopa|| 1.71cd
vidhāya sādhūnadhanānvidhātā jātānutāpaḥ sa babhūva samyak| 1.72ab tenātra kalpadrumakalpamenamenastaducchettumiva vyadhatta|| 1.72cd
jaḍāḥ prajāḥ kiṃ nu kimasya ko 'pi prabhoḥ prabhāvaḥ sadṛśaṃ yadetāḥ| 1.73ab guṇānuṣaṅgeṇa sitaṃ yaśaśca bhujadvayaṃ cāsitamīḍate sma|| 1.73cd
kṣīrāmburāśeriva bhūrisattvādabhūditaḥ ko 'pi yaśaḥśaśāṅkaḥ| 1.74ab yasyodaye svairagatirvimuktā virodhināṃ kīrtibhiritvarībhiḥ|| 1.74cd
yeṣāṃ yaśorāśiriha praśaṃsārasāyanairjīryati nādhunāpi| 1.75ab teṣāṃ gaṇe pārthivapuṅgavānāṃ yasyopasaṃkhyānamakāri dhīraiḥ|| 1.75cd
yenārjitaṃ nirjitavairiṇā tadyaśo yadantaṃ vrajadurvarāyāḥ| 1.76ab āsīmaparyantamivānugamya kṣīrāmburāśirvalate taraṅgaiḥ|| 1.76cd
ajñā rasajñā mama devi tasmāttvameva vāṇi stuhi pāṇimasya| 1.77ab yaḥ pañcaśākho 'pi sahasraśākhaṃ dānaśriyā kalpataruṃ jigāya|| 1.77cd
vṛṣe niṣaṇṇo 'pi hatārikāmo 'pyanyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ parameśvaraḥ saḥ| 1.78ab yadadrirājārcitamaṅghriyugmaṃ purānurāgaśca paraścakāse|| 1.78cd
ākramya bhūcakramaśeṣameṣa tathā kathaṃcitprabhutāṃ prapede| 1.79ab mitho yathaite 'pi diśāmadhīśā vyavasthitāḥ sīmni yadājñayeva|| 1.79cd
yadvairiṇāṃ kānanaśāyināṃ śrīḥ saṃsmaryamāṇā hṛdayaṃ dadāha| 1.80ab pārśve latāsaṃstarasuptakāntāniḥśvāsavātaprasaraśca pṛṣṭham|| 1.80cd
yataḥ krudhā bhrūkuṭibhugnabhālātpalāyamānaḥ pratipakṣavargaḥ| 1.81ab kramāgatāṃ bhūpatitāmapāsya khinnāṃ priyāṃ bhūpatitāṃ tu dadhre|| 1.81cd
athaiṣa sainyadvipabṛṃhitena nibṛṃhitāśāgajagarjitena| 1.82ab divaspṛthivyoḥ prathayanninādādvaitaṃ vijetuṃ dviṣataḥ pratasthe|| 1.82cd
prasarpatāṃ tasya turaṅgamāṇāṃ reṇuḥ kareṇudyutirudyato yaḥ| 1.83ab sa eva lebhe kliśitāridaṃśaḥ pratāpadhūmadhvajadhūmalīlām|| 1.83cd
dūtaistadabhyāgamanapravṛttau niṣpāditāyāmatha pārthivānām| 1.84ab svedāmbhasā sādhvasasambhavena bhagnāni bhālasthalacandanāni|| 1.84cd
prakurvatāmākramaṇaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ darpolbaṇānāṃ phaṇināmivaiṣaḥ| 1.85ab śirāṃsi rājanmaṇimaṇḍanāni nistriṃśadaṇḍena natiṃ nināya|| 1.85cd
sarovarāṇīva vigāhya vairirājanyasainyāni lasadrasāni| 1.86ab sa puṇḍarīkāṇi nṛpaprakāṇḍamādatta dantīva madapradīptaḥ|| 1.86cd
pratyarthidānollasadaṅgarājaparājayadyotitapāṇḍukīrtiḥ| 1.87ab kṛṣṇaṃ puraskṛtya kṛpāṇadaṇḍaṃ yadbāhurājau vijayī babhūva|| 1.87cd
tūṇādudastā dhanuranvagacchannito 'pi yātāḥ pratipakṣavakṣaḥ| 1.88ab petuḥ pṛthivyāmatha yasya bāṇāściraṃ pratiṣṭhā kva nu nirguṇānām|| 1.88cd
udgacchatāviṣkṛtapuṣkareṇa yasyāsidaṇḍena vikartanena| 1.89ab sarājatejaḥprasarā virodhisenā vināśaṃ rajanīva ninye|| 1.89cd
caṇḍasvabhāvasya cikīrṣitaṃ kaḥ prabhurniṣeddhuṃ yadasistathā hi| 1.90ab na dānataḥ satsvapi vāraṇeṣu kośānapekṣī samitau vyaraṃsīt|| 1.90cd
tyaktvā puraḥ ke 'pi nṛpāḥ kṛpāṇamamuṃ praṇemuḥ praṇatānukūlam| 1.91ab aśaktibhājāmiyameva mṛtyupratikriyāviṣkṛtavikriyeṣu|| 1.91cd
upāyanairvājimataṅgajānāṃ vijaghnureke raṇakelimasya| 1.92ab chittvāṅgulīparva ca kurvate sma śeṣāṅgarakṣāmapare narendrāḥ|| 1.92cd
yatra yoddhumadhirūḍhavāraṇe vairiṇo raṇabharātparāṅmukhāḥ| 1.93ab kṣattravṛttimapahāya kānane kṣetravṛttimabhajanta jīvitum|| 1.93cd
rājakṛtyamidamityasau kṛtī yuddhamūrdhani nṛpānapātayat| 1.94ab sampadā punaranekabhuktayā veśyayeva na vaśī vaśīkṛtaḥ|| 1.94cd
vandyā kāpi vidagdhatāsya nṛpateryasmādasau tadbhujadvandvenaiva cakāra yatkila hariścakre caturbhirbhujaiḥ| 1.95ab tadvadhyāḥ sudhiyastato 'pi yadamī yuddhodyate 'tra vyadhuḥ sarvasvairapi duṣkaraṃ nijaparitrāṇaṃ tṛṇairvaktragaiḥ|| 1.95cd
